title: Smooth curves decompose into connected curves and rational points
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure] and let $C$ be a smooth separated finite-type $k$-scheme of dimension at most one (a smooth curve of [def-sc-curves]). There are a finite set $I$, smooth separated connected one-dimensional finite-type $k$-schemes $D_i$ for $i\in I$, and a finite set $J$, with an isomorphism of $k$-schemes $C\cong(\coprod_{i\in I}D_i)\amalg(\coprod_{j\in J}\operatorname{Spec}k)$. The coprojections are open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion] and closed immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion], and each index set may be empty. Coproducts are those of [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family].
